title: 第006章 到达江海第007章 好繁华的江海
content_zh:
;;
秦延军向她回眸一笑，传音道：“云小姐，你放心，我逗他玩呢？”
云梦蝶微微一笑，放下心来。
只是，这么一笑，秦延军顿感心中暖洋洋的。
“要是能做我老婆就好了，这么漂亮的美女在身边，不得让别人羡慕死。”秦延军心中这么想着，但也不好明说。
突然，回过神来，只听王海成说道：“好处就是条件你随便开，只要我能办得到。”
“是吗？我要什么都可以？”秦延军笑嘻嘻的这么问道？
王海成一看，以为自己的计划成功，爽快的答应道：“当然当然，只要我给得起的，绝对满足你的要求！”
“那好吧！我可以答应你，不过你得有诚意才行！不然，我什么好处都没有得到，是不是我就很没面子？”秦延君继续忽悠着他。
王海成更加激动，并从口袋里拿出了自己的银行卡问道：“我这张卡里面只有300万，你说个数，这里不够，回头再给你补上。”
秦延军接过银行卡，翻来翻去看了一遍说道：“这样吧，你把你的保镖全部拿到一堆，把他们堆起来，然后倒上汽油，把它们烧了，完事了，我们再说！”
看到秦延军接过银行卡，一旁的云梦蝶开始提心吊胆，“他不是答应了保护我吗？怎么又接受王海成的银行卡，难道他就这么不靠谱吗？”
于是，就开始慢慢的移动脚步，想要坐上车开溜。
只是，她这一举动，秦延军瞬间明白，走上前去，拿着云梦蝶的手说道：“云小姐，干嘛急着走啊？你不是答应了我一个要求吗？是想毁约！”
云梦蝶看自己的心思被戳穿，一下子脸红成了苹果，强装镇定的说道：“没有，没有，我只是想拿点水喝一下，嘿嘿！”
“那好吧！快去吧，喝完水还有好戏看！”
秦延军暗自说道：“小美人，是担心我又欺骗她吧！不管了，只要他不逃走，就能带我去江海。”
这时候，王海成已经把那些保镖的尸体全部堆在了一起，开始撒汽油。
秦延军走上前去，运转功法，一串火苗出现在手指头，“你已经把它堆起来撒上了汽油，那么就由我来点火吧！”
“嗖！”

火苗落在了尸体堆上，加上汽油，熊熊的大火燃烧了起来。
王海成跑过来激动的说道：“秦大师，我的任务已经完成，你答应以后跟着我做事了吗？”
秦延军板着脸说道：“让我跟你做事，你配吗？看你这种作为就是成天玩弄女人，不务正业，就是一个典型的纨绔大少，坏事做尽，你有什么资格让我给你做事？”
停顿了一下，又道：“不过，我可以送你一件礼物，你愿意接受吗？”
王海成有些失落的说道：“唉！虽然不能帮我做事，但是有你的礼物，我就心满意足了，谢谢！”
秦延军心中好笑；傻逼玩意儿，就你还想得到我的礼物，呵呵！不知道你糟蹋了多少女孩，今后就变一个太监吧！这就是我送给你的最好礼物！

Qin Yanjun looked back at her, smiled, and said through a message: "Miss Yun, don't worry, am I teasing him?"
Yun Mengdie smiled slightly and felt relieved.
However, with such a smile, Qin Yanjun suddenly felt warm in his heart.
"It would be great if you could be my wife. With such a beautiful beauty by your side, others must not be jealous to death." Qin Yanjun thought in his heart, but he couldn't say it clearly.
Suddenly, when he came back to his senses, he only heard Wang Haicheng say: "The good thing is that you can make whatever conditions you want, as long as I can do it."
"Really? I can have anything I want?" Qin Yanjun asked with a smile?
When Wang Haicheng saw it, he thought his plan was successful and readily agreed: "Of course, of course, as long as I can afford it, I will definitely meet your requirements!"
"Okay then! I can promise you, but you have to be sincere! Otherwise, I won't get any benefits. Will I lose face?" Qin Yanjun continued to fool him.
Wang Haicheng became even more excited, and took out his bank card from his pocket and asked: "I only have 3 million in this card. You tell me the number. There is not enough here. I will make up for you later."
Qin Yanjun took the bank card, turned it over and said, "Let's do this. Get all your bodyguards into a pile, pile them up, pour gasoline on them, and burn them. When it's done, we'll talk about it!"
Seeing Qin Yanjun take the bank card, Yun Mengdie on the side began to worry, "Didn't he promise to protect me? Why did he accept Wang Haicheng's bank card again? Is he so unreliable?"
So, he started to move slowly, wanting to get in the car and drive away.
However, Qin Yanjun immediately understood her move. He walked forward, took Yun Mengdie's hand and said, "Miss Yun, why are you leaving in such a hurry? Didn't you agree to a request of mine? You want to break the contract!"
Seeing that her thoughts were exposed, Yun Mengdie blushed like an apple and said calmly: "No, no, I just want to get some water to drink, hehe!"
"Okay then! Go quickly, there will be a good show to watch after you drink the water!"
Qin Yanjun said secretly: "Little beauty, you are worried that I will deceive her again! No matter, as long as he doesn't run away, he can take me to Jianghai."
At this time, Wang Haicheng had piled all the bodyguards' bodies together and started spreading gasoline.
Qin Yanjun stepped forward and started to use the technique, and a string of flames appeared on his fingers, "You have piled it up and sprinkled it with gasoline, so let me light it!"
"Whoosh!"
The flames fell on the pile of corpses, and with the addition of gasoline, a raging fire started.
Wang Haicheng ran over and said excitedly: "Master Qin, my mission has been completed. Do you agree to work with me in the future?"
Qin Yanjun said with a straight face: "Are you worthy of letting me work with you? It seems that you are playing with women all day long and not doing your job properly. You are just a typical playboy who has done all kinds of bad things. What qualifications do you have to let me work for you?"
After a pause, he added: "However, I can give you a gift. Are you willing to accept it?"
Wang Haicheng said with some disappointment: "Oh! Although I can't help me with things, I am satisfied with your gift. Thank you!"
Qin Yanjun was amused in his heart; you are the only one who wants to get a gift from me, stupid thing, haha! I don’t know how many girls you have ruined. From now on, become a eunuch! This is the best gift I can give you!
